name: s3ListBuckets
description: Lists all buckets accessible with the resolved credentials. Returns an array of structs with bucketName and creationDate.

params.name: accessKeyId
params.description: Inline AWS access key id. Overrides credentials from Application.cfc and environment variables.

params.name: host
params.description: Inline endpoint URL for S3-compatible providers (e.g. Cloudflare R2, MinIO).

examples.title: List all buckets
examples.description: Returns an array of bucket structs.
